# Tutorial

`tutorial`

The first-steps tutorial: an ordered list of small steps that teach a new player to move, gather, build the first stations and tools, make a shelter with a bed, hunt, stay alive, find their way, grow and meet other people. Each step names the keys it teaches and the event that completes it.

> One guided path for the first hour, so the tutorial is the one place that teaches

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| chapters | json | Chapter ids in order; label tutorial.chapter.<id> |
| steps | json | Ordered steps: [{ id, chapter, inputs, requires, trigger: { kind, ...params } }]; text tutorial.<id>.title / .body |
| triggerKinds | json | The closed set of completion events: { <kind>: { required?, oneOf? } } |
| inputActions | json | Input action ids a step can name, in \`?\` controls-row order |
| windows | json | UI window keys a window_opened trigger can name |

## Actions

### progress

Show the next step and complete it from a client event

**Conditions:**
- A step is eligible when every step it requires is done and it is neither done nor dismissed
- A done or dismissed step never comes back; the whole tutorial can be turned off
- The tutorial is client-side only and changes no game state
